info.title: seedypod core API
info.description: Local, cloud-free control of a Gardyn hydroponic tower. LAN-only; no authentication.

get.summary: Identity, HAL model, limits and core version
One line per part of the unit (daemon, sensors, outputs, cameras, services): ok, idle, stalled or down
Boots on record, and how often the USB hub came up by itself lately
Home Assistant MQTT bridge: off, connected or disconnected, the broker, and the last connect error
How much core and hald log: quiet (warnings and errors), off, or debug until a time

post.summary: Set quiet or off, and open a debug window of up to 4 hours that ends by itself (0 closes it)

get.summary: What the SSH login screen shows beside the logo, flat, with ages in seconds
Wi-Fi mode (client/setup/offline), network, address, and the setup hotspot if it is up
Networks in range, strongest first

post.summary: Open the setup hotspot (closes itself after `minutes`)

delete.summary: Close the setup hotspot and rejoin the saved network

post.summary: Save a network and switch to it a moment after replying

get.summary: Latest reading for every sensor

post.summary: Store a calibration point on a pH, EC or RTD probe (EZO)
post.description: pH: `mid` first, then optional `low`/`high`. EC: `dry`, then `single` or `low`+`high`. RTD: `single`. `clear` wipes stored points. `value` is the reference solution in the reported unit (pH, mS/cm, °C).

get.summary: Configured sensor devices (with probe status) and the kinds that can be added

post.summary: Add a probe of an addable kind at an I²C address; it goes live without a restart
post.description: Refused (412) when the kind is not addable, the address is outside 0x08–0x77 or already used, the quantity is already installed, or the probe does not answer.

delete.summary: Remove a probe that was added from the app (sensors from hal.toml are refused)

get.summary: Downsampled history for a sensor
Cumulative grow-light hours (LED aging)

post.summary: Turn the grow light on/off and set brightness 0–100

until.description: When the hold ends; null holds until resumed; left out, 30 minutes

get.summary: Who controls the light now: manual hold, Autopilot or the schedule

post.summary: Change when a manual hold ends: a time, or null to hold until resumed
End a manual hold and hand the light back to Autopilot or the schedule
Run the pump; every run is bounded by the HAL max-run limit and the dry-run interlock
Run the pump for N seconds at a speed

get.summary: Your schedules, then the built-in water presets (read-only), with which one the pump cycles are now

post.summary: Save a new schedule; activate it to use it

patch.summary: Change a saved schedule; if it is the active one, the pump cycles change with it

delete.summary: Delete a saved schedule; its pump cycles stay on until another is used. A Then that named it goes back to staying in maintenance

post.summary: Use a schedule now: its cycles replace the pump cycles (and its light preset the light). Using one of yours takes watering off the grow protocol; using the current stage's preset hands it back

put.summary: Create or replace a light curve or pump cycle

post.summary: Turn Auto light on or off

get.summary: Signals rules can read, with units; liveOnly ones are unknown in a backtest

post.summary: Create a rule. New rules start in dry-run unless dryRun is false.

get.summary: Kill switch, last tick, live light leases and per-rule state
The audit log, newest first: every evaluation where a rule's trigger was active
Every rule replayed over the last days of recorded history, boiled down to a line and a sparkline

put.summary: The kill switch: off stops every rule and releases the light

post.summary: Replay a saved rule (id) or a draft (rule) over recorded history without touching hardware
Start a new grow cycle (ends any open one); startedAt (YYYY-MM-DD, the unit's local date) backdates it to the sowing day
Move the open grow cycle's start to another sowing day (startedAt, YYYY-MM-DD, the unit's local date; not after today); watering that follows the cycle re-dates to it
Start a grow cycle today and put the pump cycles on Germination (15 min at 08:00 once a week, on today's weekday), replacing the others; a retry reuses a cycle started today
Swap what two pods hold (plant, sow date, status, notes, last cut), after moving their yCubes; camera history stays with each pod position

get.summary: Harvest outlook per planted pod: ready, soon or growing, from leaf cover and any plant profile (ADR-0022)

post.summary: Record a cut: the pod goes back to growing and the camera counts only regrowth

get.summary: The grow protocol (ADR-0030): its stages with the water, light, feed and checks each sets and the date each starts on the unit's calendar; the current stage and day, hold, what comes after maintenance, whether the pump cycles are still the protocol's, and pods sown later than it

post.summary: Hold the current stage: it stays until release, and later stages start that many days later
Release a hold: the stage resumes where it was held
Advance to the next stage now; the care engine moves the watering on. Refused in maintenance, the last stage
Choose what comes after: stay in maintenance; switch to one of Your schedules now, or when maintenance begins; or a reminder at the crops' first harvest

get.summary: Setup check (ADR-0029): pods planted with no light or pump schedule on, and a tank level sensor that is absent or suspect

Chores (ADR-0029): thin, trim roots, top off, refresh, feed, clean; each due, soon, ok or unknown, from a trusted reading or a stated calendar guess, with the knowledge notes behind every dose and target

Starter Autopilot rules from the knowledge bundle (ADR-0029): pH outside 5.5–6.5, EC below the crop target, tank below half; each notify-only, with its citations, whether the unit has the sensor, and whether it is already added. A person adds one in the app, where it starts in dry-run.
The tank action log (ADR-0029), newest first: what was fed, topped off, refreshed or pH-adjusted, and when

post.summary: Record something done to the tank, such as "fed 1 tsp MaxiGro" or "added 2 mL pH Down"; touches no hardware

get.summary: Plant profiles: harvest window and leaf-cover target per crop

put.summary: Create or replace plant profiles by name

get.summary: Plant catalog (Gardyn light zones, harvest windows, care levels)

post.summary: Add a custom plant to the catalog (built-in Gardyn plants are read-only)

get.summary: Light-zone map for a Gardyn model

post.summary: Auto-place plants by light zone (Gardyn rules), with a zone summary, structured unplaced reasons and suggested moves

get.summary: Best free slots for one more plant

post.summary: Staggered sowing dates from Gardyn succession guidance

get.summary: One saved plan: request, layout, sowing schedule and overrides

put.summary: Compute and save a layout + sowing plan

patch.summary: Change a saved plan and recompute it; unspecified fields (including its start date and overrides) stay as saved

post.summary: Match free-text order lines ("Genovese Basil x2") to catalog plants, with confidence and unmatched lines
Write the plan onto the pods: wave-1 pods seeded today, later waves noted with their sow date

patch.summary: Edit a custom plant; its id stays the same

delete.summary: Remove a custom plant (saved plans keep their layout)

get.summary: One stored still by id; NOT_FOUND once pruned

post.summary: Take a still now
Take a full-size pod-ID still now (#224); not a capture, so not listed, scored or in the timelapse

get.summary: Per-pod green-area trend from the primary analyser
Analysers on the unit and any that posted results, with row counts and which is primary
Analysis queue: running, waiting, dropped, failed, re-run progress
One pod's series from every analyser@version, for side-by-side comparison
Every analyser's results for one capture

put.summary: Choose the analyser that drives pod trends

post.summary: Re-score stored captures with one on-device analyser, in the background

get.summary: The grower's label for each pod in one capture (empty, seeded, sprouted, growing, ready or unhealthy), with the pod's plant when it was labelled
How many pods carry each label, and the labelled captures, newest first
Every labelled pod, newest photo first, with its plant and age then; pass next back as cursor for the following page

put.summary: Label one pod in a capture for training (ADR-0019); null clears the label

get.summary: yCube dot codes (#224): each pod a code was read under, with the plant the owner confirmed for it (or null) and its record's plant; and every confirmed code → plant pair

post.summary: Take a full-size pod-ID still on each camera and read its dot codes (#224); slow on a Pi Zero

put.summary: Say which plant a dot code is (#224): confirms a guess or corrects it. Records and plans are left alone

delete.summary: Forget a confirmed dot code → plant pair (#224)

get.summary: Pods out of order (#224): where a confirmed dot code disagrees with the pod record or the active plan, with the record swaps that match the tower and the physical swaps that match the plan; null when all agree

post.summary: Update the pod records to match the tower (#224): applies the record swaps shown for `key`; each plant keeps its sowing date and status

get.summary: Each pod's box on each camera's stills, as fractions of the frame: the measured defaults or the owner's calibration

put.summary: Calibrate one camera's pod boxes; boxes left out keep their defaults, and null resets the camera

get.summary: What a dataset export of this window would contain (download it from GET /api/datasets/export)
Pod-state model revisions: the shipped one and every upload, which run, and which is primary
Uploads, activations, resets and rollbacks of model revisions, newest first

patch.summary: Enable or disable a revision, or make it primary

delete.summary: Delete an uploaded revision (the shipped one can't be deleted)

post.summary: Run only the shipped model again, as primary; uploads are kept, disabled
Undo the newest enable, disable, primary or reset

get.summary: SD card writes: bytes per day (7-day average, or since boot until a day of samples exists), written since boot, card size, and used/free space where the data lives
Metadata about seedypod.db, never row contents: file and WAL size, journal mode, migrations, and rows, bytes, last write and rows per hour over 24 h for each table. Cached for at least 5 minutes

post.summary: Run SQLite quick_check on a read-only connection; reads the whole file, so it can take minutes on a unit

get.summary: Off-device mirror status: enabled, uploads pending/done/failed, last error

post.summary: Write, read back and delete a probe object with the saved mirror settings
Copy the stills and artifacts already on the unit to the mirror

get.summary: Last off-card backup, nightly bucket uploads, and whether backup_stale is raised

post.summary: Back up to the mirror's bucket now (the nightly upload, early)

get.summary: Backups in the mirror's bucket (backups/), newest first

post.summary: List the backups in a bucket that isn't saved yet (Welcome → Restore); the saved mirror when config is omitted

get.summary: Whether restore is installed, the last restore or undo, and what an undo would put back

post.summary: Restore a backup from the bucket. The bundle is checked first; then the unit restarts on it (upload a file with POST /api/backup/restore)
Put back what the last restore replaced; again to redo it. The unit restarts

get.summary: Whether updates are installed, the channel, and the last or current update with its log

post.summary: Ask GitHub, through the update helper, for the newest release on the channel. Goes online
Update from stable (the latest vX.Y.Z) or dev (dev-latest)
Download, check and install the newest release on the channel. The unit restarts, and rolls back if it isn't healthy

get.summary: Whether the HomeKit bridge is on, its setup code and QR, and how many controllers are paired

post.summary: Turn the HomeKit bridge on or off; it stays off if it fails to start
Remove every HomeKit pairing and issue a new setup code and QR

get.summary: Which identity seed this unit resolves to (no seed values or codes)

post.summary: Log hap-nodejs's HAP traffic to core's journal for up to 60 minutes; 0 stops it. It turns itself off
Acknowledge an alert; clears a latched hardware fault so the actuator may re-enable
